title: Core@shell Bi2S3@Bi2O3 composites with custard apple seed-derived carbon as a high-performance anode material for sodium-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2973-2981
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00184F, Paper
Akhilesh C. Joshi, Dimple P. Dutta, Balaji R. Ravuri
Improved electrochemical performance of Bi2S3 as an anode in SIBs has been observed by forming a core@shell Bi2S3@Bi2O3 composite with custard apple seed-derived carbon.
